albums.name: Hymns IV
albums.about: These four traditional hymns for Advent were released in December of 2025. They makeup the fourth installment of our ongoing Hymns project. Though to many these might be lesser known Christmas songs, they are some of our favorites. We recorded them simply (just upright bass, guitar, an occasional mandolin, and vocals), in hopes that the words and melodies will shine, turning our attention to the 'Savior of the Nations' during the Advent season.

albums.name: The Serpent & The Seed

tracks.title: The Wheat, The Elephant, And The Mouse

albums.about: The Serpent & The Seed is a mobile adventure game with a difference: an imaginative retelling of the world's greatest story. The creator of the game, Andy Geers, reached out to us in 2021 about writing a song for one of the theatrical moments in the game. What started as a conversation about one song soon became us committing to creating the entire score. We wrote 8 lyrical works and 27 instrumentals that accompany the player throughout the experience - encompassing the Biblical narrative from creation to Revelation. The instrumentals are unique in that they're loop-based. Since players have the opportunity to go through the game at their own pace, the music must in turn lend itself to repetition for varying lengths. Despite the abnormal (for us) parameters, we wanted to release these songs as an album because we know they bring beauty to the earth and give glory to God, even apart from the gameplay. albums.name: As Foretold: Part 1
albums.about: Filling in the space between our Firstborn (Jesus’ birth) and Golgotha (Jesus’ death) projects, As Foretold is a three-album series focusing on the life of Christ. For its framework, we looked exclusively at the prophetic fulfillment passages from the Gospel of Matthew. The result is a scripture heavy journey through Jesus’ life.

albums.about: Whether it's recording a night of worship, writing a trio of Lord's Prayer songs for our friends at The Bible Project, or creating a song from Romans 8 for a family going through a difficult season, we occasionally write and record miscellaneous works. Here's a home for all those albums, singles, and EPs.

albums.about: These five traditional hymns were released in August of 2023, and all focused on the beauty of God’s creation. Having sung these standards in church growing up, these lyrical and melodic masterpieces continue to bring amazement and worship to our hearts amidst each changing season.

albums.name: EveryPsalm
albums.about: EveryPsalm is a collection of psalm-based songs. Starting at Psalm 1 and ending at Psalm 150, we released a meditative song each week for nearly three years. All the music is freely available to listen, download, or stream. The Psalter speaks to the entirety of the human experience - from feelings of triumph to loss, from communion with God to utter loneliness. The poetic nature of the Psalms lay the groundwork for its captivating beauty. Our goal in this project is to help listeners engage with the scriptures in new ways, and to bring God’s relevant and applicable word to both the normal and extraordinary times of life.

albums.about: These five traditional hymns for Advent were released in November of 2021 as the second installment of our ongoing Hymns project. The album was born out of our appreciation for these Christmas masterpieces, as these songs have consistently helped turn our hearts to gratitude and worship each Advent season.

Complementing the beautiful visual history that surrounds the "Stations of the Cross" tradition, we wrote all fourteen scripture-based original songs in just a few days at a camp in southeast Kansas. albums.name: Foreign Made

tracks.title: He Loved Us To The End

albums.about: Foreign Made was our first release, and is based entirely on the parables of Jesus. Eleven original songs come to life throughout the record telling unique stories from start to finish. The anecdotes together become a powerful picture of Jesus’ teachings. Its soundscape ranges from dark, contemplative melodies, to driving, string-band built ballads, all built to bring the lyrics into forefront prominence.
